scientific_gaps: README ring radius50mm and pixel0.5mm are metadata; source radon(circle=True) supplies parallel beams in pixels/degrees without pixel-length multiplication. Source projection values are not calibrated seconds.
Delta slowness1/c-1/1500 s/m is positive for slower1450 and negative for faster2500; main comment about fat negative is wrong. Main positivity=False; function defaultTrue differs.

Main SART label denotes full-sinogram residual/backprojection update, not verified row-normalized textbook SART. Ramp FBP, named SART30x0.15, TV300/lambda1e-6 are source settings, not measured outcomes.
Adjoint helper uses unfiltered iradon*pi/(2*n_angles); TV uses a different unfiltered backprojection and approximate norm/step convention. Exact adjoint/convergence not verified.

Generic reference_scoring header says flux-normalized, but implementation performs no flux rescale despite header prose. NRMSE=sqrt(mean squared error)/(max GT-min GT), NCC uncentered cosine. Scalar score wrapper/thresholds stay source-specific; no score executed.

task_contract.operator: Map Δs=1/c−1/c₀ through a straight-ray Radon projection and regularized inverse; convert reconstructed Δs back to speed c=1/(Δs+1/c₀). The source radon call sums slowness per pixel without multiplying by 0.5 mm, so numerical sinogram units are not calibrated seconds.

task_metric_contract.domain: Main delta-slowness centre_crop(0.8): [13:115,13:115], 102x102=10404 entries; not full-speed target
task_metric_contract.ncc: Uncentered cosine of float64 flattened arrays; either exact zero norm returns 0.0; no epsilon
task_metric_contract.nrmse: RMSE / reference range; exact zero range returns 0.0, distinct from generic infinity
task_metric_contract.ssim: skimage local structural_similarity with reference range; no zero-range guard or pinned skimage version
task_metric_contract.threshold: Main best NCC and best NRMSE may select different methods; top-level 0.9/1.1 bounds derive from cropped slowness, not generic full-speed domain; metrics.json absent.
